problem.explanation: Iterate through pairs of adjacent elements, compute their product, and find the maximum over all pairs. A list comprehension or generator with the `max()` function works elegantly.
hints: Iterate through the list from index 0 to `len(numbers) - 2`.
Keep track of the maximum product found so far.
problem.statement_markdown: Write a function `largest_product(numbers: list[int]) -> int` that takes a list of integers and returns the largest product of any two adjacent elements. If the list has fewer than two elements, return 0.
problem.title: Largest product of adjacent pair
